d: Customer Success Specialist / Technical Support SpecialistRole Description

We are seeking customer-focused and technically capable professionals to support customer relationships, service delivery, technical troubleshooting, and overall user satisfaction. The successful candidates will contribute to improving customer experiences, resolving service-related challenges, supporting product adoption, and maintaining effective communication between customers and internal teams while ensuring high service quality and operational efficiency.

Responsible for building and maintaining positive customer relationships while ensuring customers achieve their desired outcomes through the organization's products and services. Duties include managing customer accounts, assisting with onboarding and product adoption, providing guidance on product features, monitoring customer satisfaction, identifying potential service concerns, and coordinating solutions with relevant departments. The role also involves conducting customer follow-ups, maintaining account records, analyzing customer feedback, identifying opportunities for service improvements, and supporting customer retention through proactive engagement and effective relationship management.

Responsible for providing technical assistance and troubleshooting support to customers experiencing software, hardware, application, or system-related issues. Duties include diagnosing technical problems, responding to support requests, investigating system errors, guiding users through troubleshooting procedures, documenting technical cases, and escalating complex issues to relevant technical teams. The role also involves monitoring support tickets, assisting with software installations and configurations, maintaining technical knowledge resources, preparing incident reports, and collaborating with engineering and product teams to improve system reliability and customer support performance.
Degree, diploma, or relevant academic background in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Customer Service Management, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of customer relationship management, service delivery, and customer support procedures.
Familiarity with CRM platforms, helpdesk systems, ticketing tools, and customer success software.
Knowledge of technical troubleshooting, software applications, operating systems, and basic networking concepts.
Ability to identify customer needs, resolve service issues, and communicate technical information clearly.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple customer requests efficiently.
Commitment to customer satisfaction, service quality, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
